title: Rhetorical Questions and Appeals
grammar: Concessive and optative jussive clauses (legyen bármilyen ... is)
goal: I can form universal concessive clauses using verb-initial subjunctive inversion (Legyen bármilyen nehéz is...)
I can use bárki / bármi / bárhová + subjunctive + is to express unconditional resolve
I can employ high-register vocabulary of moral resolve, sacrifice, and rhetorical appeal
